option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a general term and does not specifically match any leaf disease.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is not directly related to any leaf disease.
Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis directly matches the leaf disease Chikungunya Virus Ocular Infection.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis is a specific type of Chikungunya Virus Ocular Infection.
